written.headline: Airbnb announces plans to launch an AI travel agent in 2027
written.summary: Airbnb announced in its Q3 2026 shareholder letter that it will launch an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027. The tool is designed to feature a custom interface built for travel rather than a traditional text-heavy chatbot.

written.headline: Google announces $15 billion data centre investment in Malaysia
written.summary: Google announced a $15 billion investment in Malaysia to build and expand data centre campuses and infrastructure from 2027 to 2028. The project includes adding clean energy capacity to the national grid and supporting local job creation.

written.headline: Big tech and environmental groups negotiate national data center framework
written.summary: A coalition of major technology companies and environmental groups is negotiating a national framework for data centers through a group called the Responsible Data Center Collaborative. The meetings began in September and are scheduled to continue through February 2027.
